description: X-tee teenuste linkandmed is a dataset listed in Data information gateway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Tartu Ülikool. Andmekomplektis on aprillis 2014 RIHAst korjatud andmed X-tee teenuste, teenusepakkujate ning teenuste tarbijate kohta. Andmekomplekt on korjatud ja kodeeritud Tartu Ülikooli arvutiteaduse instituudi doktorandi Svetlana Omelkova poolt ning seda kasutatakse teenuste ökosüsteemi evolutsiooni analüüsiks ning teenuste soovitamise algoritmide väljatöötamisel. Coverage: Tartu Ülikool. The portal shows the English title as "Linked Data for X-Road Services" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Tartu Ülikool. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-avaandmete-portaal.
